page.overview:
Who is Jinnah Basar?

Jinnah "Jean" Basar is a surgeon and young woman in Newfaire. She is played by Zehra Fazal.

When first seen, Jean was wearing standard-issue EONS medical clothing. All her clothes are pristine. She wears a long pale green peacoat lined in pink and white gloves.

She is extremely focused and has dark eyes and jet-black hair. "Everything about this woman on first glance is cold, cool, steady." Beneath that exterior, however, those close to her can see the warmth that urges her to heal while trying to maintain balance.

Jean first met Marion Collodi when she accompanied her father, an exorcist, to treat Marion's scar. At some point in her childhood, Jean lost her mother to an illness, and became frustrated with her father's refusal of medicine in favour of magick. Jean was inspired to pursue medicine thanks to this, also swearing off magick. Jean's skill as a surgeon was honed on the fields of war.
